decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen has repeatedly won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut and the firm publicly promotes these awards, so its visible success and the firm's public commitment make keeping it almost certain.

The dark barley malt rye bread has kept its own page through 2024 while sibling breads were dropped, which suggests it survived the portfolio review and that the investment already made in it favors continuation, though it reports no specific results.
The marzipan stollen fits the firm's award-winning seasonal stollen line and keeps its own page, so its seasonal sales cycle and its link to the stollen brand justify continued commitment.
